addons.name: ChatKeep
addons.changelog: 1.0: no changes since 0.1.0; works in game

addons.name: FlightLog
addons.changelog: Share flight times in a party: hello when the group grows, answers on the group channel.

addons.name: LevelLog
addons.changelog: Days tab: a daily gold log with start/end gold and sources. Gold on hand at each level-up (estimated for older levels), shown under the summary line. Wider window so all six tabs fit.

addons.name: PriceLog
addons.changelog: Gold tooltip on your bags: every character's gold and the total. Automatic AH scan is now the quick one (the full scan runs from the Scan AH button). Leveler: pick another profession, cheapest reagent prices and vendor prices per reagent. AH purchases show in your saved mail until you open a mailbox. AH price data from Blizzard's API is supported when the PriceLog AH addon is installed (not shared yet).

app.changelog: Add CurseForge addon: paste an addon's link from curseforge.com to install it and keep it updated. Remove from list stops updating one.
